يختفيا (form VIII)
# يَخْتَفِيَا (yaḵtafiyā) /jax.ta.fi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# يُخْتَفَيَا (yuḵtafayā) /jux.ta.fa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
